page_title: SummarizAI — Summarize, Chat & Study Any YouTube Video

sources.entry: SummarizAI - Chrome extension that adds an AI summary, chapters, chat, and Study flashcards to the YouTube watch page. #freemium

summary.name: SummarizAI
summary.one_liner: A Chrome extension that adds an AI panel to YouTube watch pages with streaming summaries, timestamped chapters, comment insights, transcript-backed chat, and study flashcards.
use_cases: Skim an hour-long video before deciding to watch it
Make exam notes and flashcards from recorded lectures
Find a specific quote or topic without scrubbing the timeline
Ask questions about a video's content
Scan audience reactions in video comments
Check claims made in a video
summary.what_it_does: The Chrome extension places a Summarize button beside Share on YouTube watch pages, opening an embedded panel or overlay. The panel streams a Markdown summary with controls for focus, format, length, emoji and bold highlights, and supports 20+ summary languages. Chapters are timestamped and clickable, seeking the player to that section. A Comments tab extracts themes from visible comments, and a Chat tab answers questions grounded in the transcript and summary. The Study tab generates flashcards from the transcript, with quiz and structured notes on Pro. Fact Check verifies claims from the summary using search-backed AI.
notable: Summary, chapters, comments, chat and study tabs all in one panel on the YouTube watch page
Clickable timestamps that seek the video player to each section
Free tier: 3 summary videos and 3 chat videos per UTC day, plus 2 flashcards per generation
Pro adds unlimited use, full quiz, structured study notes, and full Fact Check
caveats: Free tier requires sign-in and is capped at 3 summary and 3 chat videos per day (resets midnight UTC)
Quiz, structured study notes, full Fact Check and most personas require the Pro plan; Pro pricing is listed as $137 one-time for Lifetime, with subscription prices not shown on the page
Billing was reported as unavailable from the page's deployment at the time of capture
